additional_info.subject: Update
additional_info.body:
We have checked the charger logs and Router event logs.
We have observed that SIM lost internet connection around 50 times a day, which results in OCPP disconnection.
SIM is set to Manual operator.
Discussion is going on with RC-GR before sending our findings with end customer.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0367403-DC/Si-D/GR-[2lqzjn]- unstable OCPP CRM:00645000662
additional_info.body:
Hello Nikolaos,
Thank you for your patience.
We have checked the logs on our backend and router logs and found that we have multiple disconnections.
On 10th July we have observed approximately 50 times disconnections on network.
When we checked the router configuration, we can see that it is registered to "Nova" internet provider and mode is selected as Manual. All the other parameters were correct.
Can we change it to Automatic to observe if it reduces this frequent disconnection?
Awaiting your response.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav
